# YouMakeTV.ai

> YouMakeTV.ai is a streaming platform built exclusively for AI-generated films.
> Viewers browse and watch original AI movies across ten-plus genres; creators
> publish their films, keep full IP ownership, and earn a share of paid views.

YouMakeTV is an independent, AI-native platform — not a studio, not a general
video host. Every title in the catalog was made with generative tools (Sora,
Runway, Veo, Kling, Midjourney, ElevenLabs and similar), and each film page lists
the tools used to make it.

## Status

The platform is live and in **beta**. Films, studios and the catalog are real.
Payments, subscriptions and creator payouts are **not yet processed** — purchase
and payout figures shown in the creator workspace are illustrative until billing
launches. Anything on the site that names a dollar amount for a creator is a
projection, not a transaction that happened.

## For viewers

- [Browse the catalog](https://www.youmaketv.ai/) — every published AI film, by genre, studio and price.
- [Film pages](https://www.youmaketv.ai/movie/0) — synopsis, studio, runtime, content rating, language, release year, price and trailer. URLs are `/movie/<id>`.
- [Studios](https://www.youmaketv.ai/studios) — the production houses publishing on the platform. URLs are `/studio/<studio name>`.
- [YouMake+](https://www.youmaketv.ai/subscribe) — the membership: 50% off every paid film and unlimited free streaming, $4.99/month.
- Films are priced individually, from free to a few dollars. Content ratings run from G to R.

## For creators

- [Creator portal](https://www.youmaketv.ai/creator) — what publishing on YouMakeTV involves.
- [Become a creator](https://www.youmaketv.ai/creators) — revenue share (30% starting, 35% at 1,000 paid views, 40% at 5,000), review process, FAQ.
- [Creator Agreement](https://www.youmaketv.ai/creator-agreement) — licensing, ownership, moderation and payout terms.
- Creators retain full intellectual property in their films and grant only a
  non-exclusive distribution licence.

## Company and policies

## Machine-readable

- Sitemap: https://www.youmaketv.ai/sitemap.xml
- Every public page carries JSON-LD: `Movie` (with `contentRating`, `duration`,
  `offers`) and `VideoObject` on film pages, `Organization` on studio pages,
  `Organization` + `WebSite` on the homepage.
- Canonical host: `https://www.youmaketv.ai` (the apex redirects to it).
